final: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)/t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY m.Name) SELECT name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS diff_above_avg FROM r WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) ORDER BY rate DESC
